title: Behind the Bottle: Continuing the Raley Family Legacy in Bishopville, SC
summary: Teammate Tyler Raley reflects on his father’s legacy and what it means to follow in his footsteps as a multicraft mechanic at Coca-Cola Consolidated.
body_markdown:
At Coca-Cola Consolidated, our greatest strength isn’t our equipment or facilities. It’s our people.


For Teammate Tyler Raley, working on the can line at our Bishopville, South Carolina, facility is more than a job. It’s a connection to his father, Jake, who spent 38 years on that same line before retiring in 2015. Tyler followed in his father’s footsteps in January 2016 and continues the family legacy today.


In this Behind the Bottle story, Tyler reflects on their memories together, the lessons his dad left behind and what it means to carry his legacy forward.


Watch to see how the Raley family’s story demonstrates how dedication, pride and Purpose can span generations.
